body:
Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/395
Owner requested parallel implementation on 2026-09-30. Original issue intent follows; repository contracts and accepted authority remain governing.

## Summary

Add **replay of historical merges** through the post-merge workflow, with outward writes recorded rather than performed, compared against labelled expectations.

## Requested capability

- **A fixture format.** It records a merged change's identity together with its expected outcomes: affected flows, whether a follow-up item is expected, expected test gaps, and known defects. Each expectation carries `basis: generated | human-verified`.
- **`replay --change <id> --dry-run`.** It runs the whole loop using the connectors' `recording` mode and diffs the recorded requests and records against the expectations.
- **A report** that separates mismatches against human-verified expectations from mismatches against generated ones.

## Acceptance

- It works with no credentials.
- Replaying the same change twice produces identical recorded requests.
- It can be run by any CI host, or locally.

## Why

Adopters need a way to qualify the loop before letting it write to real trackers and forges, and to re-qualify it after every change to prompts, policy, or Corvint itself.
